method: Original Malden01TakeTheCar and Nogova Resistance/R01WarCry, direct developer harness, copied profiles, --nosound and synchronization validation. Shoreline roof/open-deck views plus ASL1.68144 main-pier waterline developer camera derived from live object position and original deck. Not physically walked, boat-route, all-placement or Steam acceptance. Auto/TAA100%, one bounce, RT sun/cloud shadows, AO/water/volumetrics off during cost sampling; warm10 then Off/On/On/Off settle4/sample6 at1920x1080 and2560x1440. Water on/off is a separate untimed original-feature control and restores off before timing. No build/heavy census/other game during timing. Every admitted run explicitly calls existing triSetSimTime0 after freezing simulation before each review action. The initial eight unnormalized runs are superseded, not pooled.
batchAcceptance: Original timber deck202 and wood-shingle203 keys, exact dry upper-beam569. Wet/green waterline photo is not a whole-source wood identity. Dark authored ceiling and bright mostly submerged end boards remain unregistered; no opacity, geometry, lighting, water or live-capture gate changes.
visualLimits: Five source-unknown images physically reviewed among six decoded references. Original deck includes shared submerged end geometry: source qualification is not visible floor coverage. The three end placements are submerged or expose only thin tops near water; no dedicated identity or asset/placement repair. Water optics remain raster-only coastal terrain, not invented model-bottom transmission. CPU/native water/LOD differences, spatial-only MSAA grain and settled movement captures are not clean whole-scene/MSAA equivalence or in-motion acceptance. Main-pier deck is submerged in the admitted fixed-clock views; only exposed upper beams and roof are claimed there. Initial missing-ocean deck exposure is not a material improvement. Exact original time/water-state cause is not inferred from the successful clock control.

buildArtifacts.identityLimit: Public basecfcb205 plus batch24 material data/tests before documentation commit; sourceHEAD alone does not identify loaded bytes. Original v3, earlier materials, shaders, transport, filters and all safety functions unchanged.

boundedNewSourceLimit: Raw actual eligible-hit example per observed identity, not distributions or source-specific receiver pixels. Repeated grid/phase keys may overwrite identities in the shared summary; first raw example retained here. Absence is not all-world zero or an inferred exact live gate.

simulationStateControl.observation: Initial unnormalized candidate waterline views expose the deck with missing ocean, including same-runtime native and CPU PBR-off controls. Original executable retains ocean after AA/weather/distance/CPU controls. Existing triSetSimTime0 restores ocean on the unchanged candidate executable. All admitted pairs are rerun with explicit simulation clock0 before each action; no renderer, water, source, asset or gate fix is made.
simulationStateControl.limit: The precise original time/water-state failure is not diagnosed. Initial mismatched waterline deck exposure is excluded from adoption and cost claims. A fixed-clock developer camera does not establish physical traversal, every water phase, all placement visibility or repaired model-bottom water optics.
